messages:
zoe (Recruiter): Candidate Priya S just accepted verbally. Offer proposed: base $148k, sign-on $5k, equity standard. Role is IC2-US band top $140k. They asked for 6/1 start to keep benefits continuity and have a competing offer with deadline 2026-06-02. Need fast comp exception for $8k over band.

harry (Hiring Manager): Priya is critical for uptime project. Manager recommends exception due to market and urgency. Can we approve a one-time bridging bonus instead of raising base? That keeps run-rate in band.

maya (People Ops): Two options that usually clear quickly: 1) approve one-time retention/sign-on $8k and keep base at band cap; 2) approve a permanent above-band base increase. For speed I'd route the one-time option to comp chair; requires manager justification and recruiter packet.

noah (Finance): From budget POV, one-time is easier. Confirm: sign-on taxed as income, paid on first payroll run after start. Need hiring org code and forecast impact.

hr-bot: Automated: Comp exception CE-2026-207 opened. Attach offer, manager justification, and candidate deadline. Expedited review requested (48 hrs).

olivia (Comp Chair): Reviewing CE-2026-207. Given deadline and service continuity need, approve option 1: base at band top $140k + one-time $8k sign-on. Condition: signed offer with standard clawback if candidate leaves within 90 days. Will post formal note shortly.

harry (Hiring Manager): :thumbsup: to that. Please confirm payroll timing so I can tell Priya.

noah (Finance): Payroll can execute sign-on within two pay cycles. I'll confirm exact pay date in the CE ticket.

zoe (Recruiter): I'll send formal offer with the approved one-time sign-on and 6/1 start window. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

hr-bot: Automated: CE-2026-207 status updated: APPROVED. Please attach signed offer to ticket.
